findings.title: Doylestown Health responds to emergency department incident
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Emergency rooms at Doylestown Hospital were temporarily closed after a sprinkler head was damaged and activated, resulting in water affecting eight patient rooms and adjacent office space, a Doylestown Health spokesperson said in a statement to Central Bucks Now.
findings.access_consequences: Temporary interruption of hospital emergency-room availability reported after an activated sprinkler damaged patient-care rooms; extent of diversion and current reopening status not established.
findings.affected_population: Emergency patients in the Doylestown/Bucks County hospital catchment; number unknown.
